- cc-log: Lightweight system log to record all Claude Code behavior (tool use, subagent creation, compaction, permissions, session lifecycle) for analysis. Use when the user wants to enable/disable behavior logging, analyze Claude Code session logs, list saved logs, or understand Claude Code's tool usage patterns. Trigger on: "cc-log", "behavior log", "system log", "record behavior", "log enable", "log disable", "analyze log".
- iree-optimizer: Agentic per-dispatch tile-size tuner for IREE CPU codegen on RISC-V. Keeps IREE's chosen pipeline (CPUDoubleTilingExpert / CPUConvTileAndDecomposeExpert / CPUBufferOpsTileAndVectorize) and only overrides the root linalg op's lowering_config<tile_sizes = [...]>. Each round reads the best-so-far RISC-V assembly (LMUL, VLmax, register spills) to ground the next tile-size proposal; pre-compile divisibility gate ensures tiles divide their parent extents (no tail loop); a post-compile check of the IR after iree-codegen-generic-vectorization confirms no tail/masked main path. Compiles via iree_tuner.py, benchmarks on FPGA, iterates. Use whenever the user mentions tuning IREE dispatch tile sizes, agentic tile search, or wants to replace GA-based tile-size search with LLM-driven search. Trigger on "iree optimize", "optimize dispatch", "tile tune", or references to dispatch .mlir files for performance tuning.

in the agentic_libnn_opt project. Use this skill when the user wants to optimize a
libnn function for FPGA performance, run the libnn optimization loop, validate the
optimization config, parse FPGA hardware features, extract shapes from perf test files,

Use this skill whenever someone asks to generate, write, or modify a transform dialect script, transform library, codegen strategy, or tuning spec in MLIR. 1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Andes-CSR capability parity (the flywheel / drift guard).
3	#
4	# The offline deriver (scripts/config_inc_to_andes_caps.py) computes, from a
5	# core's config.inc, which Andes CSRs it implements. The vsim
6	# engine compiles the SAME gate logic (src/hybrid/andes_caps*.hpp) and reports
7	# the list at runtime via `--describe` ("andes_csrs"). Fed the engine's OWN
8	# embedded build config.inc, the two must be byte-identical -- a disagreement
9	# means the resume/drain capability gate is wrong for that engine.
10	#
11	# Runs against EVERY built engine under $VSIM_BIN_DIR (each sim_* binary with
12	# a V<engine>/obj_sc/config.inc beside it) -- a single hardcoded engine left
13	# new engines with zero parity coverage. Uses the engine's build config.inc
14	# (the exact blob the binary embeds), so offline and online share one source.
15	# The --describe half is opportunistic: it needs the engine rebuilt with the
16	# S3 describe change (a prebuilt binary that omits "andes_csrs" is skipped).
17	set -uo pipefail
18	
19	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
20	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
21	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
22	
23	DERIVE="$ROOT/scripts/config_inc_to_andes_caps.py"
24	[ -f "$DERIVE" ] || fail "missing deriver: $DERIVE"
25	
26	VSIM_BIN_DIR="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-$ROOT/../vsim_andesim/build}"
27	
28	checked=0
29	for ENG in "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"/sim_*; do
30	  [ -x "$ENG" ] || continue
31	  name=$(basename "$ENG")            # sim_<engine>
32	  engine=${name#sim_}
33	  # The engine's embedded config.inc (copied next to its Verilated objects).
34	  CFG="$VSIM_BIN_DIR/V$engine/obj_sc/config.inc"
35	  [ -f "$CFG" ] || fail "$name present but its build config.inc not found at $CFG"
36	
37	  offline=$(python3 "$DERIVE" "$CFG") || fail "deriver failed on $CFG"
38	  [ -n "$offline" ] || fail "deriver produced an empty list for $CFG"
39	
40	  online=$("$ENG" --describe 2>/dev/null \
41	    | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(" ".join(json.load(sys.stdin).get("andes_csrs", [])))' 2>/dev/null)
42	  if [ -z "$online" ]; then
43	    echo "[skip] $name --describe has no andes_csrs (rebuild vsim with the S3 change)"
44	    continue
45	  fi
46	
47	  [ "$online" = "$offline" ] || fail \
48	    "PARITY MISMATCH ($engine): --describe andes_csrs != offline deriver"$'\n'"  describe: $online"$'\n'"  offline:  $offline"
49	  echo "[ok] $engine: --describe == offline deriver"
50	  checked=$((checked + 1))
51	done
52	
53	[ "$checked" -gt 0 ] || { echo "[skip] no built engines under $VSIM_BIN_DIR"; ok "andes caps parity (skipped)"; exit 0; }
54	ok "flywheel: --describe == offline deriver on $checked engine(s)"
55

1	# Shared status printers for test scripts. Sourced (not executed).
2	#
3	#   fail <msg...>          -> "[FAIL] <msg>" on stderr, exit 1
4	#   ok   <msg...>          -> "[ok] <msg>" on stdout
5	#   expect <rc> <re> CMD.. -> run CMD, fail unless it exits <rc> and its
6	#                             combined output matches the <re> regex
7	#
8	# These patterns were duplicated byte-identically across many test scripts.
9	# Source via:   . "$SCRIPT_DIR/<rel>/lib/log.sh"
10	
11	fail() { echo "[FAIL] $*" >&2; exit 1; }
12	ok()   { echo "[ok] $*"; }
13	
14	expect() {
15	  local want="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
16	  local out rc
17	  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
18	  [ "$rc" -eq "$want" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want for [$*]: $out"
19	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
20	}
21	
22	# Repo root, derived from this lib's own location (tests/lib/ -> ../..).
23	_LIB_ROOT=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
24	
25	# cfg_val KEY -> the value of KEY in the repo-root config.env ("" if absent).
26	# A lightweight read so a test runs without a prior `source ./setup.sh`.
27	cfg_val() { grep -oP "$1=\\K.*" "$_LIB_ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1; }
28	
29	# The external vsim build dir (the sim_* binaries), the way the driver resolves
30	# it: VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then config.env ("" when neither is set).
31	vsim_bin_dir() {
32	  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
33	  cfg_val VSIM_BIN_DIR
34	}
35

1	# Hybrid simulator per-host configuration.
2	#
3	# This file is the TEMPLATE (committed). On first `source ./setup.sh`,
4	# it is copied to ./config.env (gitignored). Edit ./config.env to point
5	# at the toolchain on your host; never commit your local edits.
6	#
7	# Both setup.sh and the test harness scripts load ./config.env at
8	# startup, so an exported value in your shell takes precedence; this
9	# file fills in the gaps when something runs without prior `source`.
10	
11	# Andes RISC-V GCC + libgloss_vh toolchain root. Must contain
12	# bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-{gcc,ld,nm,objdump,...}.
13	HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=/home/nick/nds64le-elf-newlib-v5d
14	
15	# The rv32 toolchain root (separate install), for rv32 runtime/fixture builds.
16	HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32=/local/nick/SW_Release/build-ast540/build-toolchain/linux/nds32le-elf-newlib-v5d
17	
18	# Andes RISC-V glibc/Linux-ABI toolchain root (rv64), ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md
19	# U4+. Must contain bin/riscv64-linux-{gcc,g++,ld,...}. Static-linked test
20	# fixtures only -- vlinux implements no dynamic loader.
21	LINUX_TOOLCHAIN=/local/nick/SW_Release/build-ast542/build-toolchain/linux/nds64le-linux-glibc-v5d
22	
23	# llama.cpp checkout root, ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md U8+. Needs a static
24	# riscv64 build (see docs/USER_GUIDE.md section 11) at
25	# $LLAMA_CPP_DIR/build-rv64-static/bin/llama-completion, and a GGUF model
26	# at $LLAMA_CPP_DIR/models/Bonsai-4B-Q1_0.gguf (or override both via
27	# LLAMA_COMPLETION_BIN / BONSAI_GGUF). Leave unset if you are not working
28	# on the llama.cpp-under-vlinux effort -- tests/vlinux/test_vlinux_llama_smoke.sh
29	# skips cleanly without it.
30	LLAMA_CPP_DIR=/home/nick/work/llama.cpp
31	
32	# QEMU build dir (external prebuilt qemu-system-*); added for the external-QEMU migration.
33	QEMU_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/qemu_andesim/build/qemu
34	
35	# vsim build dir (external prebuilt sim_*); added for the external-vsim migration.
36	VSIM_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build
